description: This file defines the custom exception class FeatureIdInvalidException, used within the Eclipse Ditto project to signal invalid or missing feature IDs in messages.

classes.name: FeatureIdInvalidException
classes.description: A final immutable exception class indicating that a feature ID was missing or did not match the expected value. Extends DittoRuntimeException and implements MessageException.

classes.name: FeatureIdInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for creating instances of FeatureIdInvalidException with a fluent API.

methods.name: FeatureIdInvalidException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with default headers, message, and description.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
